name: Creamy Lemon Herb Chicken with Mash and Greens

components.name: Creamy Lemon Chicken
steps: Slice chicken breasts horizontally into four thin cutlets, season with measured salt and pepper and dust lightly with 30 g flour.
Melt 40 g butter in a hot skillet; cook chicken in batches until golden and nearly fully cooked, then lift out.
Add garlic briefly; add stock, cream, lemon juice and mustard, stirring to scrape up fond. Simmer gently to thicken.
Melt parmesan into sauce and return chicken; simmer until chicken reaches at least 74°C. Stir in parsley.
Split chicken, lemon sauce, mash and broccoli into four portions; chill promptly and refrigerate for early-week use.

components.name: Mashed Potatoes
steps: Peel and cube potatoes; boil in salted water until very tender, drain thoroughly and mash with 130 ml warm milk, 20 g butter and 3 g salt.

components.name: Steamed Broccoli
steps: Steam broccoli over 200 ml water until just tender; keep separate for portioning.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Uses the published stovetop lemon chicken as a base; UNHANGRY adds measured mashed potatoes and broccoli, plus parsley. Macros must include added sides and may differ from source.
Storing & reheating: Mashed potato freezes reasonably with dairy; creamy lemon sauce may separate and crispy sear softens. Better for early-week fridge meals.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
